items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: He had a -- he had Bill Beason on drums, Hank Jones on piano. I mean these are good musicians

ctx.x: What shape did you find the Kirby band in when you came out? Who was with it? Had he kept it going in the two years?

He kept it going, but it wasn't -- it wasn't -- it wasn't. He had a -- he had Bill Beason on drums, Hank Jones on piano. I mean these are good musicians, but they weren't getting the, you know, original sound or the original --
